We checked the 64 references that supplied a DOI against the record that DOI points to, and found 1 incoherent reference to check for parsing errors or mistakes. 9 references had no DOI and could not be checked. Incoherent references are mostly PDF parsing errors (we are working on improving reference parsing). Adding a DOI to every reference that has one lets the other reference checks (retraction, PubPeer, and replication) run on them too.
